title: From Kendall Jenner to Tate McRae: are beauty consumers tired of celebrity product endorsements?
summary: Both celebrities and beauty brands are facing consumer backlash for inauthentic partnerships and questionable product demonstrations – but can the trust be rebuilt?

extraction.key_fact: 진정성 없는 협업과 의심스러운 제품 시연 때문에 셀러브리티와 뷰티 브랜드가 소비자 반발을 사고 있다.
